_comment: Epoxy — Hermes Agent Free-Tier Proxy. Pools Groq, Ollama Cloud, and Mistral API keys behind a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint with automatic rotation and cooldown handling.
name: Epoxy
author: epoxy@users.noreply.github.com
description:
Epoxy pools free-tier API keys from Groq, Ollama Cloud, and Mistral behind a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint with automatic key rotation and cooldown handling.

API keys are stored in /home/container/.env. After creating the server, go to the File Manager, open .env, and paste your comma-separated API keys for any of the three providers.

Point Hermes Agent at this proxy:
  custom_providers:
    free-pool:
      base_url: http://<server-ip>:{{SERVER_PORT}}

Models:
  groq-llama-3.1-8b-instant    (or any Groq model)
  ollama-deepseek-v4-flash:cloud  (or any Ollama model)
  ollama-minimax-m3:cloud      (MiniMax via Ollama Cloud)
  mistral-large-latest         (or any Mistral model)

Pool strategies (GROQ_POOL_STRATEGY, OLLAMA_POOL_STRATEGY, MISTRAL_POOL_STRATEGY):
  fill_first / round_robin / least_used / random

Cooldowns: 429→1h, 402→24h, 401→immediate rotation

installation.script:
set -x
set -e

apk add --no-cache curl

# fetch the latest release zip from GitHub
REPO="instax-dutta/epoxy"
VERSION=$(curl -sL "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/releases/latest" | grep -o '"tag_name": "[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4 || echo "main")

if [ "$VERSION" = "main" ]; then
  URL="https://github.com/$REPO/archive/refs/heads/main.zip"
else
  URL="https://github.com/$REPO/releases/download/$VERSION/epoxy-${VERSION#v}.zip"
fi

curl -sL "$URL" -o /tmp/epoxy.zip
unzip -o /tmp/epoxy.zip -d /tmp/epoxy-extract/

# find and copy the files (structure differs between tag zip and branch zip)
if [ -d /tmp/epoxy-extract/epoxy-main ]; then
  SRC=/tmp/epoxy-extract/epoxy-main
elif [ -d /tmp/epoxy-extract/epoxy-${VERSION#v} ]; then
  SRC=/tmp/epoxy-extract/epoxy-${VERSION#v}
else
  # fallback: take whatever single directory is in there
  SRC=$(find /tmp/epoxy-extract -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | head -1)
fi

cp "$SRC/server.py" /mnt/server/
cp "$SRC/entrypoint.sh" /mnt/server/
cp "$SRC/.env.example" /mnt/server/
cp "$SRC/requirements.txt" /mnt/server/
chmod +x /mnt/server/entrypoint.sh

echo "Epoxy v${VERSION#v} installed."
